name: captions-huge
from: the kit's lo-fi KARAOKE huge windows (modes/LOFI.md, examples/lofi/edit.py)
does: The word-by-word captions come in huge for one window: 124 px, two words a line (12 characters at most), still inside the safe zone.
use_when: lo-fi and showcase: the script asks for it ('make the captions huge', 'bigger captions'), or one punch line that should fill the band
inputs: the window of the line (at the first word, end after the last)

notes.HUGE_WORDS: words a line inside the window (the kit default 2); set KARAOKE["huge_words"] only when it differs
notes.HUGE_CHARS: characters a line inside the window (the kit default 12)

needs: KARAOKE = dict(huge=[<this window>, ...]); add huge_words / huge_chars only when they differ from 2 / 12
